preprocessing.retina: L1-L3 connectivity-inferred hex map; each eye rescaled to full image; no label-dependent calibration

readout: log1p spike counts of all selected non-directly-driven visual neurons; no outcome-driven neuron selection

nulls.method: directed double-edge swaps within exact signed weight groups
nulls.activity_interpretation_gate: Each null gray and checker readout total must be 0.1 to 10 times real, and at least 28 readout cells active; otherwise topology superiority is not interpretable; report every null

evaluation.primary_unit: visit: mean image features before train-fitted transformations
evaluation.pre_pca: train-fitted StandardScaler; remove training-constant features only
primary_comparisons: E minus mean individual F AUROC
evaluation.bootstrap: 5000 paired patient-cluster resamples of fixed OOF predictions, conditional intervals
evaluation.inference: exploratory; two positive 95% difference interval lower bounds are a pilot continuation rule, not confirmatory evidence
evaluation.subsequent: Image-level separately fitted analysis, spatially constrained nulls and MedSigLIP fusion require a separately locked extension; no claim of initial untreated diagnostic accuracy

limitations: no physiological validation of input map or neuron dynamics
same 28D does not equalize total computation or prior knowledge
paired bootstrap conditional on realized OOF predictions
first recorded visit not necessarily pretreatment
gif: actual recorded soma-associated spike counts from synthetic stimulus, fixed brightness scale, explicit simulation clock; no patient image in public illustration
public_copy_note: Redacted explanatory copy; not the original byte-identical protocol lock. No private record or embedding hashes.
